name: io.github.Tunolabs/xyzdb
title: xyzDB
description: MCP server for xyzDB: run xyTalk queries, inspect lobes and stats, take hot snapshots.

runtimeArguments.name: -v
runtimeArguments.description: Embed mode: bind-mount your xyzDB data directory to /data inside the container. The MCP server opens it directly (holds the LSM lock), so no separate xyzdb-server may run against the same dir.

data_dir.description: Absolute host path to the xyzDB data directory.

packageArguments.name: --embed
packageArguments.description: Open the data directory mounted at /data in embedded mode.

packageArguments.name: --connect
packageArguments.description: Connect mode: forward queries over TCP to an external xyzdb-server already serving the data dir.

host.description: Hostname or IP of the running xyzdb-server.

environmentVariables.name: XYZDB_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Bearer token for a xyzdb-server started with --auth-token. Required when the server enforces authentication (any non-loopback bind does).
